verdict.rationale: Zep is an agent-memory and context-graph service, not an agent or MCP host that calls tools. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is a client-side, agent-runtime capability outside its category. The evidence shows only that Zep exposes its own Memory MCP Server and Graphiti MCP Server to outside MCP clients, which is the server role and does not make this client axis applicable.
